# Carousel: Fixture — Waiting Mode
**Pattern:** The Hidden Mechanism
**Content Pillar:** Executive Function / ADHD
**Core Emotion:** Relief

### Slide 1 · Hook
- **Layout:** Template A
- **H1:** You have 17 tabs and no [[task]].
- **H2:** (waiting mode, not laziness)
- **Mascot:** Silly hunched over desk, laptop with 17 tabs

### Slide 2 · Agitation
- **Layout:** Template A
- **Body:** You had five free hours before the appointment. You did [[nothing]].
- **Mascot:** Silly staring at clock

### Slide 3 · Source Anchor
- **Layout:** Template F
- **Body:** When your brain can't track time, it parks you in [[standby]] to avoid missing what's next.
- **Source:** — Russell Barkley, *Taking Charge of Adult ADHD* (2010)
- **Mascot:** Silly reading book

### Slide 4 · Value Step 1
- **Layout:** Template B
- **Badge:** 01
- **H2:** Not laziness. [[Waiting mode]].
- **Body:** You want to start. Your system says not yet. It's still guarding what's next, so you [[hover]].

### Slide 5 · Value Step 2
- **Layout:** Template C
- **❌ Old Reaction:** "I have no discipline. I wasted five hours doing [[nothing]], what's wrong with me?"
- **✅ Regulated Response:** "I'm in [[waiting mode]]. Holding the appointment in the background, so nothing else could load."
- **Mascot:** Silly holding phone

### Slide 6 · Value Step 3
- **Layout:** Template B
- **Badge:** 02
- **H2:** If hovering at 2:47, then [[this]].
- **Body:** If you're hovering at 2:47pm with 17 tabs open, then phone face-down, set 10:00 timer, open only the document, write title only till it dings.

### Slide 7 · Value Step 4
- **Layout:** Template B
- **Badge:** 03
- **H2:** Give the wait a [[job]].
- **Body:** Don't fight the hold. Anchor it: set two timers: one to start a 10-minute starter task, one for when you must leave. The timers hold the time so your body doesn't have to.

### Slide 8 · Cheat Sheet
- **Layout:** Template D
- **H2:** Your 17-tab [[reset]]
- **Callout:** Save this for your next waiting mode
- **Bullets:**
  • Name it: "I'm in [[waiting mode]], not lazy"
  • Close 16 of the 17 tabs [[now]]
  • Set two timers: start + must-leave
  • Phone face-down, let timers [[hold]] time
- **Mascot:** Silly writing in notebook

### Slide 9 · CTA
- **Layout:** Template E
- **Closing thought:** A brain on [[standby]] isn't broken. Just holding so you don't miss what's next.
- **Primary CTA:** Send this to the friend who waits hours before an [[appointment]].
- **Handle:** @suresilly
- **Mascot:** Silly waving
